The '''Arcan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] of the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
